document_zh: 万感服务桌开办条件档案（go／no-go 七项）
document_en: Every-Sense Service Desk Readiness File (seven go/no-go items)

subject.carrier_zh: 大钟寺包容采用市场的最小物理载体：一张万感服务桌，四个位序依次为人工窗口、多通道信息位、AI 开关、退出回执位
subject.carrier_en: The smallest physical carrier of the Dazhongsi inclusive adoption market: one Every-Sense service desk whose four stations run in order — the staffed window, the multi-channel information point, the AI switch, and the exit-receipt station

overall_decision.basis_zh: 七项开办条件在授权主体确认前一律为待办，无一项具备。这一结论不是本文件新作的判断，而是包内既有枚举口径的直接汇总：《许可与协议清单》六项许可全部登记为待办、`visual/assets/op04-pilot-readiness.json` 登记为「就绪待发；无既有接触、无既有意向」、`visual/assets/seb-op04-90day-pack.json` 把每一个责任位置写为「待授权主体确认」、正文与风险台账把现场状态维持为未获授权、未现场运行。
overall_decision.basis_en: All seven readiness conditions stand as outstanding until an authorising body confirms them, and not one is met. This is not a new judgement made here but a direct summary of what the package already enumerates: all six permissions in the permissions list are registered as outstanding, `visual/assets/op04-pilot-readiness.json` reads ready to send with no prior contact and no existing intent, `visual/assets/seb-op04-90day-pack.json` writes every accountable position as pending confirmation by the authorising body, and the prose and risk register keep the on-site status at unauthorised and not running.
overall_decision.what_no_go_does_not_mean_zh: no-go 不等于方案失效，也不等于服务桌的设计判据待定。四个位序、位序不可调换的规则、以及「不消费也能停留」的承诺都是已确定的设计判据，已登记为 `PUBLIC-005` 与 `PUBLIC-007` 的要素属性；待定的是开办这张桌子所需的授权、责任、资源与演练。
overall_decision.what_no_go_does_not_mean_en: A no-go does not mean the proposal fails, nor that the desk's design criteria are undecided. The four stations, the rule that they may not be rearranged, and the commitment to staying without spending are settled design criteria already registered as feature attributes on `PUBLIC-005` and `PUBLIC-007`. What remains open is the authorisation, accountability, resources and drills needed to open the desk.

items.current_state_zh: 无。《许可与协议清单》场地使用行登记为待办，覆盖内容为「公共产权或书面授权，授权期须覆盖试验期与撤除期」，缺失时的后果为「该点位不得进入 L1」。截至登记日本方案团队未与任何场地方、运营主体或授权主体发生接触，不存在任何意向、约定或承诺。
items.current_state_en: None. The site-use row of the permissions list is registered as outstanding, covering public ownership or written permission whose term spans both the trial period and removal, and its absence means the node may not enter L1. As of the registration date the team has approached no site owner, operator or authorising body, and no intent, arrangement or commitment exists.
items.fill_owner_zh: 场地运营与法务（《许可与协议清单》场地使用行的责任专业）
items.fill_owner_en: Site operations and legal counsel, the responsible disciplines named on the site-use row of the permissions list
items.fill_condition_zh: 取得限定范围、限定时段、可撤回的书面场地使用授权，授权期同时覆盖试验期与撤除期，并在 G0 资料与许可闸门前完成来源登记；未取得前该点位不得进入 L1。
items.fill_condition_en: A written, bounded and revocable site-use permission whose term spans both the trial period and removal, registered before the G0 evidence-and-permission gate; until then the node may not enter L1.

items.current_state_zh: 仅有概念级矩阵，无生效安排。`seb-op04-90day-pack.json` 的 RACI 登记五个角色（场地运营方、无障碍专业人员、参与者代表、维护方、监督方），全部 A 角色写为「待授权主体确认」；数据活动 AC-4 明确登记角色缺口——该活动的 R 角色在五个角色中没有对应者，须由授权主体另行指定第六个角色。同时登记利益冲突纪律：维护方即本方案团队，是被审对象的作者，在现场审计与停止决定两类活动上不得担任 R 或复核人。
items.current_state_en: A concept-level matrix only, with nothing in force. The RACI in `seb-op04-90day-pack.json` registers five roles — site operator, accessibility professionals, participant representatives, maintainer, oversight — with every A position written as pending confirmation by the authorising body. Activity AC-4, data, carries an explicit role gap: none of the five roles can hold its R, and the authorising body must name a sixth. A conflict-of-interest rule is registered alongside: the maintainer is this proposal's team and the author of what is examined, so it may hold neither R nor reviewer on site audits or stop decisions.
items.fill_owner_zh: 未来经授权的项目发起或运营主体（risk.json R-02 的 owner_role）
items.fill_owner_en: The future authorised initiating or operating body, the owner role of R-02 in risk.json
items.fill_condition_zh: 按 R-02 恢复条件填写：形成书面 RACI、工作边界、依赖责任和闸门记录，且授权范围与可撤回条件一致；数据活动的 R 角色由授权主体单独指定数据治理专业人员，不得由维护方兼任。
items.fill_condition_en: Filled under R-02's resume condition: a written RACI, work boundary, dependency accountability and gate record, with the scope of authorisation consistent with the revocation terms; the R for the data activity is named separately by the authorising body as a data-governance professional and never doubled up with the maintainer.

items.current_state_zh: 六项许可与协议（伦理审查、知情同意、场地使用、保险与责任、数据处置、影像与素材）在授权主体确认前一律为待办，任何一项缺失，对应闸门不得放行。保险部分在包内只有投保建议，明示不是保险方案、不是产品推荐、不是保险经纪意见；本方案不点名任何保险人、产品或经纪机构，也不具备提供保险建议的资质。保险与责任行的缺失后果为「不得安装任何构件」——这是停止条件，不是流程建议。
items.current_state_en: All six permissions and agreements — ethics review, informed consent, site use, insurance and liability, data disposal, and imagery and material rights — stand outstanding until an authorising body confirms them, and any one missing bars its gate. On insurance the package holds recommendations only, stated explicitly as neither an insurance scheme nor a product recommendation nor broker advice; it names no insurer, product or broker and claims no qualification to advise on insurance. The consequence of a missing insurance-and-liability row is that no component may be installed — a stop condition, not a process suggestion.
items.fill_owner_zh: 伦理审查与共创主持（伦理审查、知情同意）、法务与安全（保险与责任）、数据治理（数据处置）、法务与运营（影像与素材）、场地运营与法务（场地使用）
items.fill_owner_en: Ethics review and co-design facilitation for ethics review and informed consent; legal and safety for insurance and liability; data governance for data disposal; legal and operations for imagery and materials; and site operations and legal for site use
items.fill_condition_zh: 六项逐项取得并登记；保单期须同时覆盖试验期与撤除期，与场地使用授权期口径一致；保单在撤除期结束前失效即构成停止条件，构件须在保单失效前撤除，不得以「即将撤除」为由裸奔。
items.fill_condition_en: All six obtained and registered item by item; the policy term must span both the trial period and removal on the same footing as the site permission, and a policy lapsing before removal ends is itself a stop condition — components come down before the policy lapses, never left uncovered on the grounds that removal is imminent.

items.current_state_zh: 服务桌本身没有独立预算科目。包内唯一的预算是 `seb-op04-90day-pack.json` 针对单一概念点位 OP-04 的九十天概念级估算区间（合计 35.2—82.8 万元人民币，含应急与退出预留），该文件明示为概念级估算，不是造价文件、不是报价、不是承诺，且不含土建、不含永久工程、不含轨道或市政主体的工程内容、不含全包级共享工作。运维一侧包内只有班次结构与响应时限的建议值，且明确写明响应时限一级与二级为建议值、待授权主体结合真实班次与劳务条件核定。两类预算因此都不存在可用的服务桌口径数字。
items.current_state_en: The desk has no budget line of its own. The only budget in the package is the ninety-day concept-level range in `seb-op04-90day-pack.json` for the single conceptual node OP-04 (35.2 to 82.8 in CNY 10,000 including the contingency and exit reserve), which that file states is a concept-level estimate and not a cost document, a quotation or a commitment, and which excludes civil works, permanent construction, any rail or municipal engineering content, and package-level shared work. On the operating side the package holds only recommended shift structures and response times, with the first- and second-tier response times marked as recommendations pending confirmation by the authorising body against real rosters and labour conditions. Neither budget class therefore has a usable service-desk figure.
items.fill_owner_zh: 未来经授权的项目发起或运营主体（建设口径）与运营负责人、维护负责人（运维口径，risk.json R-04 的 owner_role）
items.fill_owner_en: The future authorised initiating or operating body for construction, and the operations and maintenance leads for operation — the owner roles of R-04 in risk.json
items.fill_condition_zh: 按 R-04 恢复条件填写：责任人、班次、备件、维护与演练记录闭合，并由 G3 确认资源与开放范围匹配。同时必须确认 R-04 的机器规则：不得以 AI 提效为名削减值守班次，不得把接管压力与 AI 层运维成本转嫁为一线值守者的无偿加班——该条一经违反即触发停止条件。
items.fill_condition_en: Filled under R-04's resume condition: accountable persons, shifts, spares, maintenance and drill records closed, with G3 confirming that resources match the scope opened. R-04's machine rule must be confirmed at the same time: shifts may not be cut in the name of AI efficiency, and handover load and AI-layer running costs may not be passed through as unpaid overtime for front-line staff — breaching that triggers the stop condition.

items.current_state_zh: 维护边界、频次与报修路径在包内为概念建议，频次为首次给出的设计目标值、待授权主体核定。数据一侧，《许可与协议清单》数据处置行登记为待办，缺失时的后果为「测量记录不得开始」；`ethics-protocol.json` 的六份协议全篇明示为未经伦理复核的模板，零参与者、零测试、零记录。因此既没有生效的维护安排，也没有一次实际发生过的数据处置。
items.current_state_en: Maintenance boundaries, frequencies and the fault-reporting path are concept-level recommendations, the frequencies being first-stated design targets pending confirmation by the authorising body. On the data side the data-disposal row of the permissions list is outstanding and its absence means measurement records may not begin, while the six protocols in `ethics-protocol.json` are stated throughout as templates that have passed no ethics review, with zero participants, zero tests and zero records. There is thus neither a maintenance arrangement in force nor a single instance of data disposal having occurred.
items.fill_owner_zh: 数据治理专业人员与参与者代表（risk.json R-01 的 owner_role）负责数据留存与处置；维护负责人负责维护频次、备件与报修路径
items.fill_owner_en: Data-governance professionals and participant representatives, the owner roles of R-01 in risk.json, for retention and disposal; the maintenance lead for frequency, spares and the fault-reporting path
items.fill_condition_zh: 按 R-01 恢复条件填写：G0 批准协议，完成可撤回同意与处置演练，并由 G3 核验匿名化结果和实际处置记录；数据用途、最少字段、访问范围、撤回或到期处置任一项无法解释和记录即触发停止条件。
items.fill_condition_en: Filled under R-01's resume condition: G0 approves the protocol, revocable consent and disposal are rehearsed, and G3 verifies the anonymisation outcome and the actual disposal record; if any one of purpose, minimum fields, access scope, withdrawal or time-bounded disposal cannot be explained and recorded, the stop condition triggers.

items.current_state_zh: 判据已定、资源未定。位序规则本身是已确定的设计判据——人工窗口先于一切 AI 构件设立，退出回执位永远在最后一步之后仍然在场；「不消费也能停留」已作为属性登记于两处前厅类公共空间要素。但没有任何一个值守班次、任何一名值守人员、任何一条经核定的响应时限：包内班表与 SLA 均为概念建议，一级与二级响应时限明示为建议值待核定，三级为停止条件触发即停止的规则本身。
items.current_state_en: The criterion is settled; the resources are not. The station order is a settled design criterion — the staffed window stands before any AI component, and the exit-receipt station remains present after the last step — and staying without spending is already registered as an attribute on both foyer-class public-space features. But there is no staffed shift, no staff member and no confirmed response time: the rosters and SLA in the package are concept-level recommendations, the first and second response tiers stated as recommendations pending confirmation, and the third tier being the stop-means-stop rule itself.
items.fill_owner_zh: 运营负责人和维护负责人（risk.json R-04 的 owner_role），非 AI 通道底线由运营方与资产接收方共同确认（risk.json R-12 的 owner_role）
items.fill_owner_en: The operations and maintenance leads, the owner roles of R-04 in risk.json, with the non-AI channel floor confirmed jointly by the operator and the receiving asset holder, the owner roles of R-12
items.fill_condition_zh: 按 R-04 恢复条件填写班次与响应链并由 G3 核对；非 AI 通道底线按 R-12 停止条件确认——`non_ai_channel_floor` 任一项被改为可削减即触发停止。没有明确值守班次、备件、维护卡、故障绕行或人工接管资源时不得开办。
items.fill_condition_en: Shifts and the response chain are filled under R-04's resume condition and checked at G3; the non-AI channel floor is confirmed under R-12's stop condition, which triggers the moment any floor item is made reducible. The desk may not open without defined shifts, spares, maintenance cards, a fault detour, or human-handover resources.
derived_from: proposal.md#其二，万感服务桌的四个位序不可调换

items.current_state_zh: 未有任何一次演练发生。包内登记两类演练要求：AI 关闭日演练（G2 收尾连续一个完整测试日全程关闭态运行，演练记录含未完成任务及原因、不预设全部完成，作为 G3 必交证据）与独立接管演练六项清单（两名非原团队人员在无供应商在场条件下逐项完成并签收）。两者均为设计要求，均无执行记录；`exit_plan` 全篇为概念建议，退出成本计入应急与退出预留科目而非实际支出。
items.current_state_en: No drill has taken place. The package registers two drill requirements: the AI-off day drill, one full consecutive test day run entirely in the off state closing G2, whose record must include unfinished tasks and their causes and never presume full completion, and which is a mandatory exhibit at G3; and the six-item independent takeover drill, completed and signed item by item by two people from outside the original team with no vendor present. Both are design requirements with no execution record, and the whole exit plan is a concept-level recommendation whose exit cost sits in the contingency reserve rather than in actual spend.
items.fill_owner_zh: 运营方与资产接收方（risk.json R-12 的 owner_role）执行；由未参与制作的独立专业人员与参与者代表在 G3 复核
items.fill_owner_en: The operator and the receiving asset holder, the owner roles of R-12 in risk.json, with independent professionals who did not build the prototype and participant representatives reviewing at G3
items.fill_condition_zh: 按 R-12 恢复条件填写：修订后的退役方案经三方复核确认非 AI 通道完整存续，撤除与验收的证据分离、非 AI 通道存续证据单独归档；并按 R-11 恢复条件，三方复核签署续期并写入新的 `review_due`，运行声明的 `as_of_date` 晚于任一 L4b 节点的 `review_due` 即立即按 L0 对待。
items.fill_condition_en: Filled under R-12's resume condition: a revised decommissioning plan confirmed by the three-way review as leaving the non-AI channel intact, with removal evidence separated from acceptance evidence and the channel-survival evidence archived on its own; and under R-11's resume condition, a renewal signed by the three-way review and written into a new `review_due`, with any operating declaration whose `as_of_date` passes a L4b node's `review_due` treated immediately as L0.

gate_binding.rationale_zh: 四道闸门缺一不可，未通过 G3 不进入开放空间。服务桌是面向公众的商业前厅界面，属开放空间构件，因此其开办闸门为 G3；G3 结论按基准 v0.4 四选一：通过、有条件通过、退回整改，或关闭 AI 层保留服务。
gate_binding.rationale_en: All four gates are required and nothing enters open space before G3. The desk is a public-facing commercial foyer interface and therefore an open-space component, so its enablement gate is G3, whose conclusion is one of the four baseline v0.4 outcomes: pass, conditional pass, return for rework, or close the AI layer and retain the service.
gate_binding.note_zh: 关闭 AI 层保留服务这一结论对服务桌尤其具体：四个位序中只有 AI 开关位属 AI 层，其余三位在该结论下继续运行。
gate_binding.note_en: The fourth outcome is unusually concrete for this desk: of the four stations only the AI switch belongs to the AI layer, and the other three keep running under it.

limitations_zh: 本文件是开办条件的登记，不是可行性研究、不是投资决策文件、不是采购或保险文件。
全部 null 字段为如实空缺，不得以估算值、目标值或模板值填充；填写者与填写条件逐项写明，条件未满足前该字段保持为 null。
本文件不产生任何指标数值；`metrics.json` 中十项待实测指标保持 unknown。
七项结论的依据全部取自包内既有登记，本文件不新增任何事实，也不代任何一方作出承诺。
limitations_en: This file registers readiness conditions. It is not a feasibility study, an investment decision document, or a procurement or insurance document.

Every null field is a truthful blank and may not be filled with an estimate, a target or a template value; the owner and condition for filling each is stated, and until the condition is met the field stays null.
This file produces no metric value; the ten pending metrics in `metrics.json` stay unknown.
The basis for all seven conclusions is drawn from registrations already in the package; this file adds no fact and makes no commitment on anyone's behalf.
